findings.topic: Final Thursday designations supersede Tuesday estimates
findings.text: JSN was full Wednesday with no game-status designation. Charbonnet is out. Denver ruled out Surtain and Hufanga and lists Moss questionable. Both official team reports corroborate the statuses, but they are overlapping reporting of the same event, not independent predictive signals. No game-day inactive list reviewed. Thursday kickoff is October 15 at 20:15 EDT.
findings.confidence: HIGH for reported statuses; workload and matchup effects uncertain

findings.topic: Wednesday estimate is not an observed practice
findings.text: Carolina did not practice Wednesday. Waller (toe) and Tremble (ribs) were estimated limited; Freeling (knee) and Dillon (ankle) estimated nonparticipants. The headline's wording does not establish final Sunday OUT designations. Thursday actual practice and Friday game statuses are still needed.

findings.topic: Return designation, participation and game activation are different gates
findings.text: Cleveland announced Sampson eligible to return to practice. Its Wednesday injury table lists Sampson (knee) and Judkins (ankle) as DNP, with Thursday/Friday and game status unresolved. Designated return does not prove activation, a healthy workload, or a vacated backfield share. Several offensive-line injuries also require monitoring before translating possible carries into efficiency.
findings.confidence: HIGH for official report; future role unresolved

findings.topic: Positive participation still needs a final-status check
findings.text: Dallas and Green Bay's official Wednesday reporting shows Lamb full with a thigh issue. Baltimore's portion of the Browns-Ravens report shows Andrews full with a hand issue. These are Wednesday observations, not guarantees about Sunday health or usage.

findings.topic: A strong late quarter does not establish a permanent role shift
findings.text: Denver reports 29 team rush attempts Sunday and six Dobbins fourth-quarter carries averaging 6.8 yards, plus his touchdown. Those observations support reviewing volume and game script; they do not establish his full-game route, target, carry or goal-line share. Denver also reported 1-of-12 on third down, a reminder that possessions and offensive success affect volume.
findings.confidence: HIGH for reported game facts; LOW for extrapolated future share

educational_lesson.central_method: Model opportunity with health and game-script scenarios; distinguish tempo from total play volume.
educational_lesson.source_lesson: Thorman explains that seconds per snap and offensive play count need not move together because possessions, offensive success, opponents and game state matter. His older historical examples and reported neutral-pace R-squared of .45 were not independently reproduced here or validated for 2026. The current Week 6 public introduction defines a neutral filter; filtering is a modeling choice, not proof that excluded plays are irrelevant.
educational_lesson.mathematics: Own derivation: E[targets] = sum over scenarios s of P(s) * E[dropbacks * route participation * targets per route | s]. Multiplying unconditional averages assumes away dependence. A script can change all three factors together. A fantasy mean is not a reception-prop tail probability.
educational_lesson.synthetic_example: Teaching inputs only: 32 dropbacks x .85 route participation x .24 targets per route = 6.528 expected targets; 38 x .85 x .24 = 7.752. The 1.224 difference assumes fixed rates. No player forecast or executable wager is implied.
assumptions: Scenario probabilities require evidence and calibration.
Routes and dropbacks must use consistent provider definitions and denominators.
Historical sample must handle injuries, overtime and coaching changes without hindsight.
Availability evidence does not by itself identify snap limits or target redistribution.
challenged_assumptions: Faster pace alone guarantees more opportunities.
A full practice ensures normal usage.
A teammate's absence transfers all missing work to one replacement.
A touchdown or late-game burst proves sustainable improvement.
educational_lesson.test: Freeze a recent-volume baseline and a joint health/script model before each game. Use chronological held-out weeks and the same candidate set. Compare dropback, route and target MAE and interval coverage; score explicit role/availability probabilities with Brier score and calibration plots only when resolved sample size supports them. Record all failed predictions. Do not optimize filters on the evaluation weeks.
educational_lesson.failure_conditions: Reject the extra complexity if held-out errors/coverage do not improve, improvement relies on future information, or opportunity estimates become less robust across plausible injury scenarios.
educational_lesson.evidence_grade: A for probability/accounting identity under stated definitions; B for transparent educator reasoning; C for empirical gain until tested.

general_hub_application.text: Mongo should evaluate Cleveland backfield scenarios only after return/activation and participation checks, then verify its own current ESPN eligibility and available replacements. A public return designation does not establish platform IR eligibility or a free roster slot. Wednesday Lamb and Andrews participation is useful evidence for later lineup review.
